bibl.title: I tre moschettieri… ad Antinoupolis, 1965.
bibl.seg: 160 Barocas Claudio Forte Francesco Manfredi Manfredo 241 Antinoopolis 810
Anna Di Giglio & Rosario Pintaudi, I tre moschettieri… ad Antinoupolis, 1965.
bibl.note: Three photographs, taken during the excavation campaign, conducted at Antinoe in 1965, show the friendship between three great scholars capable of having fun and joking together, perhaps also to lighten the hard living conditions in the morning on the excavation, under the sun scorching, due to the high temperatures and, during the rest of the day, to cope with all the daily difficulties that arose from time to time in the mission house.
